title: Draft RAS v0.2: requirements text in standards style
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. docs/standard/RAS-v0.1.md has many TBDs and informal wording. ASTM F24 expects defined terms and 'shall' requirements. Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Rewrite RAS as v0.2 in standards style (scope, normative references by title only, terms, requirements with 'shall'), resolving TBDs derivable from existing analysis and listing the rest.
acceptanceCriteria: No text copied from paid standards
Each 'shall' maps to a conformance test or inspection (by ID)
Design-arounds kept (mechanical or wired release only; sensor principle per ras-latch.md)
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
